# Netba

> NetbaDB is a strongly typed relational database core in Rust. NetbaIoT is a memory-only IoT gateway for MQTT, TCP, and UDP. They are independent programs.

## NetbaDB

- [Get started](https://netba.net/start): Embedded netbadb-sdk and remote Protocol v2.
- [Query language](https://netba.net/query), [architecture](https://netba.net/architecture), [storage](https://netba.net/storage), and [roadmap](https://netba.net/roadmap).
- [License](https://netba.net/license): AGPL-3.0-or-later. MSRV 1.85.

## NetbaIoT

- [Overview](https://netba.net/iot): MQTT 3.1.1 and a bounded MQTT 5.0 profile, framed TCP, authenticated UDP, confirmed webhook and Business RPC sinks.
- [Get started](https://netba.net/iot/start): Run `cargo run --locked -p netbaiot-cli -- demo --once`, then initialize a gateway configuration.
- [Architecture](https://netba.net/iot/architecture): Bounded memory routing and live sessions.
- Version 0.6.6, MSRV 1.88. See the [commercial license](https://netba.net/iot/license); it permits a 30-day internal non-production evaluation. Historical AGPL rights apply to their respective copies.
- EventAccepted is not business persistence. Required sinks ACK; retries may duplicate event_id.
- HTTP is management-only. Commands target online local MQTT or TCP sessions; offline commands are not stored.
- Planned shutdown waits in memory for required sink ACKs. Forced exit loses pending events; runtime and MQTT state start empty after restart.

Chinese pages live under `/zh`. English is the default locale.
